wardrobe.description: Which reference sheet to render from. 'none' means no people in frame — a still life or empty room carrying the topic, used for roughly one article in four so the same face does not appear on every cover.

scene_description.description: What is happening in the photograph, tied to the article topic (2-3 sentences)

background.description: Setting: lab bench, office desk, library, clinic corridor, park path, home kitchen. Include the environmental details that make it a real room rather than a backdrop

pose.description: Shot type (WIDE / MEDIUM / CLOSE) plus the one clear action and how the hands are occupied. Empty when wardrobe is 'none'

expression.description: Facial expression — absorbed, considering, checking, listening. Never posing to camera. Empty when wardrobe is 'none'

props.description: 1-3 physical objects relevant to the topic, none carrying readable text, numbers, labels or screens

text_bubble.description: The key takeaway in one Ukrainian sentence. Used downstream as caption text only — nothing in the image carries text

color_notes.description: How the neutral palette leans for this scene: cool and clinical, warm and domestic, grey and overcast
